title: The Echo Chamber of Returning Storms

features.name: the storm cycle that argues with itself
features.desc-on-touch: rain falls; then thunder speaks; then lightning comes – but also: lightning strikes; thunder speaks; rain follows; also: they arrive all at once; the chamber holds all three sequences

features.name: the frequency stone
features.desc-on-touch: the low drone of an old recording; play it forwards and backwards it's the same; the storm has memorized it

features.name: the archive's microphone
features.desc-on-touch: recording the same rainfall again and again; each time the drops arrive in different order; each time the music is different; each time it is identical

features.name: the standing water where refrains collect
features.desc-on-touch: echoes of echoes of echoes; the last thing the rain said is the first thing the next rain learns; you remember standing here before

features.name: the conversation the storm has with itself
features.desc-on-touch: words arrive in random order, but the meaning holds; the storm learns it can say anything and still mean rain

reverie.title: REVERIE — the pool where the storm learned to remember
narr: you wade into the standing water while lightning pulses overhead
she stands on the bank, recording the rainfall on the device
the rain is speaking but you can't hear what it says
she rewinds the recording; the same speech plays backward
it means something different each way; both are true
the storm has learned it can say anything and still mean itself

inscription: the storm returns here to hear itself speak; each return adds a new voice to the chorus; the echo has become the original

file.name: Dust_Frequency_Storm_Rearrangement.mp3
file.note: a field recording of one storm played in three temporal orders simultaneously; each contradicts the last; all are true; the archive broadcasts all versions at once

exits.label: back to where rain and music first became each other
toward chambers where weather learns to sing in the dark
upward to where the echo begins to dream
